name: headroom
description: Rate-limit, context and prompt-cache meters above the prompt, with keep-warm and cache-miss warnings

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto follows Claude Code's own rule (1h on a subscription, 5m on API keys or extra usage); or force 5m / 1h

keepWarmHours.title: Keep-warm duration (hours)
keepWarmHours.description: How long keep-warm pings continue after your last message

autoKeepWarmTokens.title: Auto keep-warm threshold (tokens)
autoKeepWarmTokens.description: Turn keep-warm on by itself once the context reaches this size; 0 turns it off

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Toast at 80% and 95% of a usage window and on a cache miss; notify before the cache expires
